tools.name: wechat_status
tools.description: Show whether the local WeChat bridge is up, which WeChat account it is attached to, and the bridge-side whitelists.

summary.zh: 看微信桥通不通、挂的是哪个号、白名单是什么。
summary.en: Shows bridge health, the attached account and the whitelists.

tools.name: wechat_chats
tools.description: List recent WeChat conversations with unread counts and the last message. Does not switch the WeChat window.

summary.zh: 列最近的微信会话和未读数，不切微信窗口。
summary.en: Lists recent WeChat chats with unread counts, without switching windows.

tools.name: wechat_read
tools.description: Read the latest messages of one WeChat conversation (private chat or group). Switches the WeChat window to that chat and marks it read.

chat.description: Exact conversation name as shown in WeChat, e.g. 文件传输助手.

summary.zh: 读某个私聊或群最近的消息（会切窗口并标记已读）。
summary.en: Reads recent messages of one chat (switches the window, marks read).

tools.name: wechat_send
tools.description: Send a WeChat text message to one conversation. Only conversations on the bridge allowSend whitelist are accepted; a refusal comes back as an error.

chat.description: Exact conversation name, e.g. 文件传输助手.

summary.zh: 给白名单里的会话发一条微信文字消息。
summary.en: Sends a text message to a whitelisted conversation.

tools.name: wechat_send_voice
tools.description: Send a WeChat voice bubble (语音条) to one conversation: the bridge synthesizes the text into speech, plays it into a virtual microphone and records it as a voice message. Takes about 10-15 seconds. Only allowSend whitelist conversations are accepted.

chat.description: Exact conversation name, e.g. 文件传输助手.

text.description: What the voice bubble should say.

summary.zh: 给白名单里的会话发一条语音气泡（现场合成、经虚拟声卡录进微信）。
summary.en: Sends a voice bubble to a whitelisted conversation.

tools.name: wechat_reply
tools.description: Reply to a WeChat conversation, randomly as a text message or as a voice bubble (~40% voice). Use this for ordinary replies in groups and private chats so the mix stays natural; it reports which form went out.

chat.description: Exact conversation name, e.g. 摸鱼🐟🐟🐟🐟F.

summary.zh: 回一条微信消息，随机用文字或语音（四成语音）。
summary.en: Replies randomly as text or voice (~40% voice).

tools.name: wechat_emoji
tools.description: Send one of WeChat's own emoji/stickers chosen by keyword: the bridge opens the emoji panel, searches the keyword (Chinese works best: 摸鱼/无语/开心/晚安) and taps the first result. Only allowSend whitelist conversations are accepted.

chat.description: Exact conversation name, e.g. 摸鱼🐟🐟🐟🐟F.

query.description: Keyword searched in the emoji panel, e.g. 摸鱼.

summary.zh: 按关键词搜微信自带表情并点第一格发出去（笑脸→放大镜→搜索→点图）。
summary.en: Sends a built-in WeChat emoji by keyword (opens the panel, searches, taps the first result).

description.zh: 白名单会话里来了新消息。
description.en: A new message arrived in a whitelisted conversation.

changelog.0.2.5: - 首次公开发布（`cortico-world-weixin-link`）：本地 wxauto4 桥 + 状态/开关面板 + 微信自带表情
changelog.0.2.4:
- 新增 `worlds.wechat.stickerChance`：发完文字后跟一张微信表情的概率，面板「开关」里可调
- 换掉旧的贴纸库表情：改为按关键词搜微信自带表情并点第一格发送（`wechat_emoji`）
- 表情发送改为慢速点击 + 每步校验，主窗口/面板点击前抬到最前，切会话空面板时重试
- 面板：「微信表情」功能行、扫描会话 + 下拉加入监听、监听名单勾选
changelog.0.2.3:
- 新增「扫描会话」：桥先把微信窗口恢复出来再读会话列表，结果进下拉菜单
- 监听会话支持勾选与「跟随桥白名单」
changelog.0.2.2: - 面板：状态与功能进度、开关、监听会话
changelog.0.2.1: - 修正 WebUI 产物缓存：面板改动需要升版本
changelog.0.2.0: - 第一个带 WebUI 面板的版本
